design_coverage.reason: The source reports annual cross-sectional fits but does not identify any fixed-effect dimension or explicitly state that fixed effects are absent. Year is the repeated-fit dimension, not a year fixed effect.
No observation-level cluster variable is specified. Yearly coefficient averages use the time-series distribution; rating-model tenure coefficients also receive an autocorrelation correction.
Annual cross-sectional estimates are averaged across 1990–2000; t-statistics use the time-series variability of annual coefficients.

design_coverage.reason: The source reports annual cross-sectional fits but does not identify any fixed-effect dimension or explicitly state that fixed effects are absent. Year is the repeated-fit dimension, not a year fixed effect.
No observation-level cluster variable is specified. Yearly coefficient averages use the time-series distribution; rating-model tenure coefficients also receive an autocorrelation correction.
Annual cross-sectional estimates are averaged across 1990–2000; t-statistics use the time-series variability of annual coefficients.

implementation_issues.description: The benchmark, exact return-adjustment convention and estimator for Beta computed from 60 monthly returns are not reported. The CRSP market return used for CAR does not by itself identify this Beta benchmark.

The source uses 2001 Compustat active/research, CRSP and I/B/E/S vintages. Exact historical population, outcome-specific yearly fit N, restricted ≥5-year tenure sample, and issuer/security link coverage are not established by current field probes.

Legacy Compustat items #18, #25/#199, #9/#34/#6, #149, quarterly #8/#61/#17 and S&P #282/#280 must be mapped to source-era series and category codes. The current debt-rating column is not evidence for the separate common-stock ranking measure.

For analyst forecasts the source requires the mean one-year-ahead forecast for t issued immediately after the t−1 earnings announcement. The target fiscal period, origin snapshot and the 1990–2000 sample-year label must be retained separately; exact table-year endpoint convention is not explicit.

For stock/debt ratings, the authors use an additional second-order autocorrelation correction for tenure-related t-statistics. The supplied printed correction-factor equation is corrupted and is not reproducible as transcribed.
